title: Momentum & Collisions
intro: Rolling debes, crashing marbles and safe bodas: momentum, impulse and why crumple zones save lives.

lessons.title: Mass in Motion: Introducing Momentum
lessons.focus: p = mv; which is harder to stop: fast football or slow rolling debe? Stopping stories build the idea.
lessons.advanced: Compare p for a 0.45 kg ball at 25 m/s vs a 15 kg debe at 1 m/s; stopping distance implications.

lessons.title: Why Momentum Matters on the Road
lessons.focus: Boda braking distance grows with load and speed; overloaded pickups; momentum as 'quantity of motion'.
lessons.advanced: Doubling speed doubles p but quadruples KE: which governs braking distance and which crash violence? Discuss.

lessons.title: Impulse: The Egg-Catching Secret
lessons.focus: Δp = F×t; soft hands extend time and reduce force; landing with bent knees; gym mats and sand pits.
lessons.advanced: 60 g egg at 6 m/s stopped in 0.5 s (cloth) vs 0.02 s (floor): compute both forces and the verdict.

lessons.title: Follow-Through: Impulse in Sport
lessons.focus: Long contact adds impulse: javelin run-up, football kick follow-through, jembe swing; analyze slow-motion descriptions.
lessons.advanced: Estimate: javelin 0.8 kg accelerated over 1.2 s of contact to 25 m/s: average force?

lessons.title: Collisions That Bounce
lessons.focus: Marbles and bottle tops on a smooth board; equal masses 'swap speeds'; line-of-centres idea.
lessons.advanced: Equal-mass head-on collision: prove speed-swap from conservation of p and KE together.

lessons.title: Collisions That Stick
lessons.focus: Clay lumps collide and move on together; momentum conserved, KE not; where the KE went (deformation heat).
lessons.advanced: 2 kg clay at 3 m/s hits stationary 1 kg and sticks: final speed and the KE lost — account for it.

lessons.title: Conservation of Momentum
lessons.focus: Two trolleys spring apart: equal and opposite momenta from rest; measure masses and speeds to check.
lessons.advanced: 3 kg cart moves off at 0.5 m/s as a 2 kg cart recoils at 0.75 m/s: verify conservation numerically.

lessons.title: Safe 'Explosions': Springs and Balloons
lessons.focus: Balloon release propels a bottle boat; spring-apart carts; internal forces only redistribute momentum.
lessons.advanced: Balloon 50 g ejects air backward: explain the boat's forward p with momentum bookkeeping.

lessons.title: Recoil: Stepping Off the Dugout
lessons.focus: Step off a low-friction plank on rollers and it slides back; canoe push-offs; firefighter hose kickback stories.
lessons.advanced: 60 kg student steps off at 2 m/s from a 20 kg plank: plank recoil speed?

lessons.title: Rockets Are Momentum Machines
lessons.focus: Revisit the Unit 4 water rocket: mass out the back, rocket forward; why staged pumps beat single blasts.
lessons.advanced: Estimate thrust: 0.5 L expelled in 0.15 s at 20 m/s — average force and peak acceleration of a 0.3 kg rocket.

lessons.title: Crumple Zones and Cushions
lessons.focus: Egg on foam vs floor revisited with numbers; crumple zones extend collision time; helmet foam anatomy.
lessons.advanced: Design spec: keep head force under 300 N for a 3 m fall onto a helmet liner — estimate needed crush distance.

lessons.title: Project: Boda Safety Physics Campaign
lessons.focus: Turn impulse, braking and momentum data into posters for the local boda stage; peer-test the messages.
lessons.advanced: Include one quantitative panel: compute a braking distance at 40 vs 60 km/h with realistic deceleration.

lessons.title: Momentum Games: Carrom and Marbles Tourney
lessons.focus: Angles and speed transfer in carrom breaks and marbles; predict rebounds; run a scored mini-tournament.
lessons.advanced: Analyze a glancing collision: momentum as vectors; why does the striker deflect rather than stop?

lessons.title: Build: A Bottle-Top Newton's Cradle
lessons.focus: Five nuts/tops on V-strings in a frame; tune contact for clean transfers; one swings in, one swings out.
lessons.advanced: Explain why two-in produces two-out using both conservation laws, not momentum alone.

lessons.title: Momentum in Water and Air
lessons.focus: Hose jet pushes back; river bends erode the outside bank; fanning air moves paper; fluid momentum in daily life.
lessons.advanced: Hose delivers 0.5 kg/s at 4 m/s: compute the reaction force on the holder's hands.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Collision Lab Day
lessons.focus: Stations: marble swaps, clay sticks, cradle demo, impulse egg test; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Open-ended: design an experiment to verify conservation of momentum with only a ruler, stopwatch and two carts.
